mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal monetary tightening during labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month
regime_hint: monetary tightening during labor market weakness
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS and UNRATE both rise as specified.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production indicates robust supply growth, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales below 360,000 million dollars signals weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS falls below 360000.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation coupled with stable federal funds rate indicates persistent inflationary pressure, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp and FEDFUNDS remains > 0.15% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with stable monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS remains stable as specified.

mechanism_narrative: In labor market recovery, a decline in non-farm payrolls signals weakening employment momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In labor market recovery periods, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines.
